items.title: Stefon Harris interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 11, 2020
items.q: The transcript contains no mention of Monk (Thelonious Monk) in relation to Stefon Harris, only a closing remark by the interviewer thanking 'Monk and Stefon' (likely referring to the interviewer Monk and interviewee Stefon, or a typo for another name, but no personal relationship between Stefon and

ctx.x: Thank you for the work you’re doing to keep the music alive and it really is something that we all need right now.

Thank you, I would agree. And thank you for the work that you’re doing to keep the music alive. So I think we’re out of time. This goes until 12:50, we have students maybe who need to get back to class and people that need to get back to their desks. So thank you very much, Monk and Stefon for taking the time to talk to each other and to let us listen in. It was fantastic. I feel like I’ve learned so much in this hour. So thank you and enjoy the rest of your day, enjoy your weekend and be well.
Okay thank you. Over and out. © Fillius Jazz Archive -15-
